Votes are counted by riding and party before pixels are placed. Each coloured pixel represents the stated number of votes for one party in one riding. Grey pixels contain votes for multiple parties or fewer votes than stated. Point at a pixel to see its counts. Locations are illustrative, use populated areas from 2025 estimates, and do not show how neighbourhoods voted.
